caption:
Surah Al-Mulk on why life is a test

Allah created death and life to test which of us is best in deeds. Not the most, the best. And He is the All-Mighty, the Most Forgiving.

Surah Al-Mulk 67:1-2

Choose one deed today and do it as well as you can.

#lifeisatest #surahmulk #bestindeeds #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
